name: Davey-Boy O'Brien
aka: The Solid Man with the Magic Mustache
caption: A Scottish singles wrestler managed into the SCW Lonestar Tag Team Championship by his mentor Keegan, upsetting Las Preguntas at Showdown I in a Texas Tornado grudge match.

tenures.role: wrestler — SCW Lonestar Tag Team Champion (with Keegan)
tenures.hometown: "The Journey's End, Scotland" (billed in reference to John O'Groats, Scotland)
tenures.finisher: Journey's End (a modified Jim Breaks Special)
signature_moves: A Square Go (three alternating European Uppercuts finished with a Discus Forearm Shiver)
Land's End to John O'Groats (Coast to Coast Dropkick)
tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler-application bio (app019.html, held) and the federation's own served showdown1.html, winning the Lonestar Tag Team Championship alongside Keegan.

name: Keegan
caption: A Newcastle-born wrestler and three-time Fighting Zone Champion who mentored Davey-Boy O'Brien to the SCW Lonestar Tag Team Championship at Showdown I.

identity.note: The federation's own real booking-committee member of the same first name introduces himself out of character in the FAQ ("Hello, I'm Keegan and I've been involved in this game, on and off, since 2001, mainly in angle feds") and is never billed on-screen. This row is the on-screen wrestler only, billed "from Newcastle, England," a three-time Fighting Zone Champion, Davey-Boy O'Brien's mentor and tag partner (showdown1.html).

tenures.role: wrestler — mentor to Davey-Boy O'Brien; SCW Lonestar Tag Team Champion (with Davey-Boy O'Brien)
tenures.source: The federation's own served showdown1.html: "First, from Newcastle, England... KEEGAN!", billed "a three time Fighting Zone Champion," Davey-Boy O'Brien's mentor and tag partner, his fingers previously broken by Alex Reyn.
tenures.note: No dedicated wrestler-application page survives for this character (he is not listed on the federation's own roster.html); the tenure is sourced entirely from the federation's own show text (showdown1.html, and rampage0006.html/rampage0007.html for the build to the title match).

name: El Gringo Loco
caption: Leader of the Cartel and mouthpiece of Las Preguntas, El Gringo Loco led the first Lonestar Tag Team Champions to the ring on nearly every SCW broadcast.

identity.note: VWF's El Gringo Loco (2003–2004) was a masked luchador wrestler with a bodyguard, later hosting a talk segment as Flash; SCW's, sixteen years on, is a manager leading the Cartel. The name is a stock one, and nothing connects the two.

tenures.role: manager — leader of the Cartel; manager of Las Preguntas
tenures.source: The federation's own Rampage broadcasts (June 2019 to January 2020) and its Showdown I supercard (8 December 2019).

name: CK Beretta
caption: A Virginian face in the mould of Magnum T.A., CK Beretta arrived after SCW lifted its signing freeze and debuted against Billy James.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app025.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Alfie Button
caption: A London high-flyer finishing with a 720 DDT, Alfie Button chased the Lonestar Heavyweight Championship into the triangle match that crowned Caleb Foley.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app013.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: "The Fat Man" Steve Dann
caption: A 370-pound Louisianan, "The Fat Man" Steve Dann flattened SCW opponents with the Cookie Cutter.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (openerapp03.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: "Ubiytsa" Kostya Demidov
caption: A Russian-born heel living in New York, "Ubiytsa" Kostya Demidov joined SCW's January 2020 broadcasts with "The Death Blow."

tenures.hometown: Born in Russia, resides in New York, NY

entrance_music.title: I'm a Bad Man
entrance_music.verbatim: "I'm a Bad Man" by Dark Country

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app029.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Flanagan
caption: Billed from "The Local Pub," Flanagan finished SCW opponents with the Jägerbomb and was billed into its first Television Title gauntlet.

identity.note: Shares only the surname Flanagan with wrestlers of other federations; nothing connects them.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (openerapp04.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Jed Johnson
caption: A 25-year-old suplex specialist with a decade on the road, Jed Johnson worked SCW's cards through Showdown I.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (openerapp02.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: "The Law" John Henry Jones
caption: A Luckenbach Texan in a cowboy hat and duster, "The Law" John Henry Jones won his SCW debut and was billed against El Principe' for the first shot at its new Television Title.

entrance_music.title: The Man Comes Around
entrance_music.verbatim: The Man Comes Around by Johnny Cash

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app028.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: El Principe'
caption: A technically gifted wrestler from Mexico City, El Principe' fought his way out of SCW's dark matches into a match for the first shot at its new Television Title.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app012.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Alex Reyn
caption: A heel of unknown origin with a contract status nobody could pin down, Alex Reyn broke the fingers of Davey-Boy O'Brien's mentor in the build to Showdown I.

identity.note: PCW's Alex Reynolds shares only a similar name; nothing connects the two.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app027.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: "Big Kid" Chris Smith
caption: A 390-pound "Big Kid" billed from "The Playground," Chris Smith finished SCW opponents with School's Out.

identity.note: NGW's Chris Smith shares only the name; nothing connects him to SCW's "Big Kid".

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app011.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Joe Public
caption: A Lynchburg everyman managed by Plain Jane, Joe Public finished SCW opponents with Public Demand; SCW's own news listed him among the names lost after Showdown I.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (openerapp05.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.
